headline: Apple opens Siri AI to third-party apps and ends beta waitlist
summary: Apple rolled out Siri AI integration with third-party apps as part of an iOS 27 update, letting the assistant draw on personal context and on-screen awareness in developer-tested apps. The Register notes Apple had promised this more than two years earlier, and ZDNet reports the Siri AI beta waitlist has now ended for users.
